description: What the Florida AHCA Medicaid Sanctioned Providers data covers and how current it is: total sanction final orders, how many are participation exclusions (suspensions/terminations) vs. fines and corrective action plans, distinct providers, how many orders carry an NPI, license or Medicaid provider number, the violation-code counts with AHCA's published key, the oldest and newest sanction dates, and when this pack's copy was captured. Use to check the screening data is fresh enough to rely on before a compliance decision, and to read the notes on the sanction-vs-exclusion distinction and the derived end dates. Pass year (e.g. 2025) or start_date/end_date to instead COUNT orders by sanction_date in that year or range, counted over the whole 7,000+ row list, not a page — answers "how many Florida Medicaid exclusions took effect in 2025". Returns participation_exclusion_count (suspensions + terminations only — the real exclusions) separately from all_sanction_orders_count (which also includes fines/CAPs, not exclusions); the response says which is which. Sourced from AHCA's Public Records final-orders search, keyless.
name: fl_medical_exclusion_coverage
